page.overview:
What is Ammutseba?

Ammutseba, also known as the Devourer of Stars or the Daughter of Isfet, is a Great Old One in the expanded Cthulhu Mythos. The character was originally created by Ann K. Schwader for her short story "Lost Stars", and later incorporated into Chaosium's role-playing game Call of Cthulhu. (: Secrets of Kenya)

Ammutseba is described as a dark black vapor cloud with wispy, black, misty tentacles that floats in the sky and absorbs falling stars and all lights. (: Secrets of Kenya)

She has also been represented as a woman-shaped black hole. (: "Lost Stars")

She is said to be the daughter of an entity named Isfet, who is the abstract representation of chaos in Egyptian mythology. Egyptologist Martin Stanley inferred this to be Azathoth. (: "Lost Stars")
